inline:The causal-mechanism explanation asserts that the fourth cut passes through exactly 3 existing pieces, but under the stated condition that all cuts pass through the exact center, the fourth concurrent line actually passes through 4 regions, so the stated derivation is unsound.
The problem-context asks for the number of pieces produced by four straight cuts through the exact center. The target’s mechanism explains the count by saying the nth cut passes through n existing pieces (3 for the fourth cut) and divides only those, yielding 8. For concurrent lines through the center, however, the fourth line crosses the previous three lines all at the same point, so after crossing that shared point it enters a different region and then exits the circle, passing through 4 regions total; thus the incremental count is based on the wrong mechanism.
